hotspots.title: Javier Milei's Central Bank reform push
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei is aggressively pushing for a comprehensive reform of the Central Bank, aiming to limit its functions to preserving currency value and prohibit monetary financing of public spending. The reform is a cornerstone of his economic agenda and is being fast-tracked through legislative meetings with allies.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes framing as a make-or-break moment for Milei's libertarian economic model, with intense moral and ideological polarization over the reform's implications for Argentina's financial stability and sovereignty.

hotspots.title: Iran's revenge threats against Western leaders
hotspots.blurb: Iran has escalated tensions by publishing a 'revenge list' targeting 13 Western leaders, including Donald Trump, Benjamin Netanyahu, and Giorgia Meloni, following the assassination of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The U.S. has responded with new strikes and threats of a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its alarmist framing as an existential geopolitical crisis, with intense fearmongering over potential military escalation and targeted assassinations of global leaders.

hotspots.title: Hungary's constitutional crisis over president's term
hotspots.blurb: Hungary's parliament, led by Prime Minister Péter Magyar's Tisza party, has voted to remove President Tamás Sulyok from office through a controversial constitutional amendment. The move has sparked protests, resignations, and accusations of authoritarian overreach, with Fidesz boycotting the vote.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its framing as a democratic backslide, with intense moral outrage over the perceived power grab and erosion of judicial independence, alongside polarized contention between the ruling party and opposition.

hotspots.title: Death of Senator Lindsey Graham
hotspots.blurb: The sudden death of U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham, a key ally of Donald Trump, has sparked tributes, conspiracy theories, and speculation about the political fallout. Graham's passing leaves a significant vacancy in the Senate, with implications for Trump's agenda and the 2026 midterms.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its framing as a pivotal moment for U.S. politics, with intense affective investment in Graham's legacy, polarized speculation about the cause of death, and moral outrage over perceived exploitation of the tragedy for political gain.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen's 2027 presidential bid in France has been thrown into uncertainty after a court upheld her conviction for embezzling EU funds, raising questions about her eligibility. The ruling has sparked intense debate about judicial interference in politics and the future of the far-right National Rally.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes framing as a defining moment for French democracy, with intense moral outrage over perceived judicial bias, polarized contention between supporters and critics, and alarmist speculation about the far-right's electoral prospects.
